messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: Omeprazole is used to treat excess stomach acid in conditions such as stomach ulcers, heartburn or gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), active duodenal ulcer, Zollinger-Ellison syndrome and erosive esophagitis.
Omeprazole may also be given together with antibiotics to treat gastric ulcers caused by infection with Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori), in adult patients.
Omeprazole is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that works by blocking the acid pump in your stomach, reducing how much acid it makes and giving irritated or damaged tissue a chance to heal.
Omeprazole brand names are Prilosec, Prilosec OTC, and generic brands are available.
Omeprazole is available over the counter (OTC) and as a prescription medication.
